Seven claims share phone 713-555-2172: C-1026, C-1202, C-1209, C-1322, C-1331, C-1350 and C-1418.

This is a possible link between these claims. The data note adds a caution. Several claims from one claimant can share that claimant's phone. That is not network evidence on its own. So this link alone does not show an unusual pattern.

No claim ID was given, so this is a lookup of one phone number. No scoring rules fired. The evidence has no rule IDs, rule names or document quotes. It also lists no rules in not_evaluated_rule_ids, so I cannot say which rules were not checked. No score was provided. If coverage is low, any score may be too low.

Next step: this needs human review. An investigator should check whether all seven claims belong to the same claimant. If they do, the shared phone is expected. If they belong to different people, the shared number is an unusual pattern and needs a closer look. The evidence does not say which case applies. It does not support any conclusion about wrongdoing.
